min_diff = 1e9
best_num = 0
best_den = 1

for b in range(1, int(n) + 1):
    a_candidate1 = int(math.ceil(b * x / y))
    a_candidate2 = int(math.floor(b * x / y))
    
    diff1 = abs(x / y - a_candidate1 / b)
    if diff1 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff1
        best_num = a_candidate1
        best_den = b

    diff2 = abs(x / y - a_candidate2 / b)
    if diff2 < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff2
        best_num = a_candidate2
        best_den = b

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
